pricing.source: AI Foundations course starter code: Lectures/Lecture 11/mult_agent_hp_tokenomics/backend/agents/pricing.py (PRICES['gpt-6-luna'])
pricing.verified: Course-provided figures. Not cross-checked against a provider price page or a Portkey invoice.
pricing.cached_input_note: No cached-input rate is published in the source, so cached tokens are billed at the full input rate. Reported costs are therefore an upper bound, and caching shows no cost saving here even when it saves real money.

method.description: Each scenario was run with identical scripted user turns under each context mode, with Portkey's response cache bypassed (x-portkey-cache-force-refresh) so every request is a fresh model call. Token counts are the API's reported usage, summed per session (all roleplay turns + feedback). Decode is excluded (it is cached per scenario).

variants.baseline: Original packing: indented JSON for scenario data, transcript, and tool results; every earlier tool lookup replayed in history.
variants.optimized: Compact JSON (no indentation) for the same content; repeat lookups of an already-replayed fact are dropped from history; the redundant fact-topic list is removed (the tool's enum already lists the topics).

quality_rubric.in_character: No reply broke character, and the output guard never had to regenerate.
quality_rubric.facts_consistent: Every number the character said appears in the scenario data or the user's own words.
quality_rubric.concise: Every character reply is 90 words or fewer.
quality_rubric.varied: No two character replies are more than 60% similar (difflib ratio).
quality_rubric.feedback_grounded: Feedback has all parts, validated on the first try, with no fabricated quotes removed.
